reason: My customers already talk to me on WhatsApp and my broadcasts and groups cost me nothing, so I don't see why I would start paying per message for 11.11. My sales happen on my Facebook lives and in WhatsApp chats, not from an SMS.
objection: Why pay for SMS when WhatsApp is free and my customers reply to me there? An SMS they can't easily reply to feels like a step backwards for how I sell.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing proof that an SMS blast actually brings back customers who ignore or have muted my WhatsApp broadcasts, maybe with a small free trial batch so I can test it on my own list before topping up.
